nphi.title: Rospotrebnadzor mobile laboratory support for Ebola response in Uganda and Republic of Congo
nphi.with: Ugandan and Congolese laboratory specialists (no institutes named)
nphi.summary: Under Russia's programme of support to African countries against infections, a Rospotrebnadzor mobile laboratory in Uganda was redeployed to the border with the DRC for Ebola testing, and Congolese specialists were trained and supported…

nphi.title: BRICS NPHI online meeting hosted by NCDC India (2026)
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.with: China CDC; NPHIs of BRICS members and partner countries (nearly 30 representatives)
nphi.summary: Under India's 2026 BRICS chairship, NCDC hosted an online meeting of national public health institutes from BRICS members and partner countries, which discussed surveillance and early warning and the operational framework of a BRICS NPHI…

nphi.title: Russian–Vietnamese study on antibiotic resistance of enteric pathogens (Nha Trang)
nphi.with: Pasteur Institute in Nha Trang
nphi.summary: Joint study under a memorandum between the St Petersburg Pasteur Institute and the Pasteur Institute in Nha Trang on causes of acute intestinal infections and antibiotic resistance in food and clinical samples, framed as One Health.

nphi.title: BRICS Vaccine Research and Development Centre (coordinated by ICMR-NIV)
nphi.with: BRICS member states' health and research agencies
nphi.summary: The BRICS Vaccine Research and Development Centre was launched virtually in 2024 during India's BRICS presidency, with ICMR-NIV Pune as the coordinating agency. It aims to strengthen vaccine R&D and health systems across BRICS member…

nphi.title: China CDC – Rospotrebnadzor cooperation memorandum
nphi.with: Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumer Rights Protection and Human Wellbeing (Rospotrebnadzor)
nphi.summary: Cooperation memorandum signed in 2020 covering infectious disease research, prevention and COVID-19 experience sharing. The heads of both agencies met in Beijing in 2024 to plan further exchanges.

nphi.title: China–Russia Infectious Disease Symposium series
nphi.with: Smorodintsev Research Institute of Influenza; National Research Center for Fundamental and Translational Medicine; other Russian institutes
nphi.summary: Annual bilateral symposium on infectious disease prevention and control, co-organised by China CDC and Russia's Smorodintsev Influenza Institute since 2018; the eighth edition was held in Saint Petersburg in 2025.

nphi.title: Russian-Guinean Research Centre for Epidemiology and Prevention of Infectious Diseases (Kindia)
nphi.with: Russian-Guinean Research Centre for Epidemiology and Prevention of Infectious Diseases, Institut de Recherche en Biologie Appliquée de Guinée (IRBAG), Kindia; RUSAL (funding)
nphi.summary: Centre opened in 2017 at IRBAG with Rospotrebnadzor support that diagnoses more than 40 infections, supported measles and COVID-19 response, and has been part of training over 1,000 Guinean specialists since 2015.

nphi.title: BRICS TB Research Network meetings
nphi.with: BRICS TB research network partners
nphi.summary: China CDC's TB centre hosted the 11th BRICS tuberculosis research meeting online in 2022, where 34 BRICS scholars and officials discussed mitigating COVID-19's impact on TB.

nphi.title: Russia–Kyrgyzstan biosecurity cooperation: mobile laboratories for dangerous infections
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Kyrgyzstan
nphi.summary: As part of long-standing cooperation, Russia handed Kyrgyzstan a mobile PCR/ELISA lab and an inflatable field lab in 2025, adding to earlier mobile units. Russian and Kyrgyz mobile labs have jointly examined plague foci.

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)
nphi.with: Pasteur Network members incl. Institut Pasteur de Dakar, de Bangui, de Côte d'Ivoire, de Guinée, du Maroc, de Madagascar, de Tunis, d'Algérie, du Cambodge, du Laos, Korea, Montevideo, São Paulo; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; CERMES Niger; Fiocruz; NIHE, Pasteur Institutes Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute of Iran; HKU-Pasteur Research Pole; Sciensano; Stephan Angeloff Institute; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; Institut Pasteur in Saint Petersburg
nphi.summary: Global network of about 33 public health and research institutes in 25 countries and territories, many of them national reference laboratories or NPHIs, collaborating on infectious disease surveillance, research and training.

nphi.title: Saint Petersburg Pasteur Institute – INHRR joint diagnostic research
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Higiene Rafael Rangel (INHRR)
nphi.summary: Russian experts agreed a joint research plan with Venezuela's national hygiene institute in Caracas in June 2026, covering laboratory diagnosis of viral hepatitis, measles, rubella, parvovirus B19, diphtheria and pertussis with Russian…

nphi.title: Seminar on Plague Prevention and Control in SCO Countries
nphi.with: Plague and public health experts from SCO member and observer states; Wu Lien-Teh Foundation
nphi.summary: A 2025 Beijing seminar, followed by a Xinjiang–Central Asia technical exchange, to advance technical collaboration and joint plague control mechanisms among SCO countries.

nphi.title: Russia–Ethiopia joint emergency response exercise and mobile laboratory agreement
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI); Ethiopian Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: Rospotrebnadzor ran a three-day rapid-response and mobile-laboratory exercise in Addis Ababa with about 100 participants from 15 African countries, and signed an agreement with Ethiopia's health ministry to supply a mobile laboratory and…

nphi.title: Rospotrebnadzor–Uzbekistan sanitary-epidemiological cooperation (mobile laboratories)
nphi.with: Committee on Sanitary-Epidemiological Welfare and Public Health of Uzbekistan; Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: Rospotrebnadzor handed over two mobile anti-epidemic laboratories to Uzbekistan in April 2024 as part of more than ten joint projects covering IHR implementation, HIV, plague, antimicrobial resistance and population immunity.

nphi.title: Pasteur Institute of Iran – Saint Petersburg Pasteur Institute memorandum of cooperation
nphi.with: Saint Petersburg Pasteur Institute
nphi.summary: Memorandum of cooperation in biological research, education and training signed in Saint Petersburg in September 2022.

nphi.title: Quadrilateral plague prevention and control cooperation (China–Russia–Mongolia–Kazakhstan)
nphi.with: Russian Research Anti-Plague Institute 'Microbe'; National Center for Zoonotic Disease (Mongolia); National Scientific Center for Especially Dangerous Infections (Kazakhstan)
nphi.summary: China CDC hosted a 2021 webinar with plague institutes from Russia, Mongolia and Kazakhstan to share plague control technologies and work toward a joint cross-border plague control mechanism.

nphi.title: Rospotrebnadzor 'Microbe' institute sanitary-epidemiological assessment mission to Tajikistan
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Population of Tajikistan
nphi.summary: In 2021 experts from Rospotrebnadzor's Microbe anti-plague institute visited Tajik laboratories and medical institutions to assess the sanitary-epidemiological situation, following the Tajik–Russian intergovernmental commission.

nphi.title: Gamaleya–Torlak technology transfer for local Sputnik V production
nphi.actor: Gamaleya National Research Centre for Epidemiology and Microbiology
nphi.with: Institute of Virology, Vaccines and Sera Torlak
nphi.summary: Following an April 2021 technology-transfer agreement, the Torlak institute in Belgrade produced Sputnik V, with the first batch passing quality control at the Gamaleya Centre in May 2021.

nphi.title: EMiL – European standards for mobile diagnostic laboratories
nphi.with: UK Public Health Rapid Support Team; Public Health England; Institut Pasteur (France); Rospotrebnadzor (Russia); CTMA UCLouvain (Belgium); WHO EURO; GOARN; BNITM; Bundeswehr Institute of Microbiology (Germany)
nphi.summary: Developed minimum standards and audit for rapid response mobile labs and links to EMTs.

nphi.title: China CDC–Rospotrebnadzor memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Rospotrebnadzor (Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumer Rights Protection and Human Wellbeing)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2020 on communicable disease prevention and control, emergency preparedness and response, and joint laboratory research methods.

nphi.title: China CDC–Gamaleya–Smorodintsev tripartite memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Gamaleya National Research Center of Epidemiology and Microbiology; Smorodintsev Research Institute of Influenza
nphi.summary: Tripartite MoU signed in 2018 on infectious disease diagnostics and training.

nphi.title: Rospotrebnadzor–Armenia agreement on international health regulations and diagnostics cooperation
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Armenia
nphi.summary: During a 2018 visit to Saratov, Armenia's health ministry signed an agreement with Rospotrebnadzor on introducing international medical-sanitary rules and agreed joint work with the Microbe institute on diagnostic tests.

nphi.title: Russian–Vietnamese joint research on enterovirus molecular epidemiology
nphi.actor: Blokhina Nizhny Novgorod Research Institute of Epidemiology and Microbiology (Rospotrebnadzor)
nphi.with: Vietnamese institutes in Hanoi, Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City
nphi.summary: Joint research from 2017 to 2021 on molecular epidemiology and diagnostics of enterovirus infections, reviewed at a December 2021 seminar where both sides proposed extending cooperation to pneumonia and antibiotic resistance, hepatitis E…

nphi.title: Mechnikov Latin American Biotechnology Institute – Russia–Nicaragua vaccine plant
nphi.actor: Russian Ministry of Health / FMBA – St Petersburg Research Institute of Vaccines and Serums
nphi.with: Instituto Latinoamericano de Biotecnología Mechnikov (Managua); Nicaraguan Ministry of Health; PAHO/WHO
nphi.summary: Influenza vaccine and biologicals plant in Managua, largely financed by Russia and opened in 2016 as a production site of the St Petersburg Institute of Vaccines and Serums; its flu vaccine obtained WHO prequalification in 2025.

nphi.title: Russia–Guinea scientific and technical cooperation on infectious diseases
nphi.with: Institute of Applied Biology of Guinea (Kindia); Rospotrebnadzor
nphi.summary: Rospotrebnadzor-backed programme in which the St Petersburg Pasteur Institute worked with Guinea's Institute of Applied Biology in Kindia on epidemiology, prevention and monitoring of bacterial and viral infections; a closing conference…

nphi.title: ICMR – Russian Foundation for Basic Research MoU
nphi.with: Russian Foundation for Basic Research (RFBR)
nphi.summary: ICMR signed an MoU with the Russian Foundation for Basic Research in December 2014 for bilateral biomedical research cooperation.

nphi.title: Rospotrebnadzor–Vietnam MoH memorandum on sanitary-epidemiological well-being and food safety
nphi.with: Vietnam Ministry of Health; Joint Russian–Vietnamese Tropical Research and Technological Center; Federal Scientific Center for Medical and Preventive Health Risk Management Technologies
nphi.summary: MoU signed in Hanoi in November 2013 with a support programme to 2016 covering sanitary-epidemiological well-being, chemical food safety in bilateral trade, staff training and joint research.
